subject: Evaluation plan: compliance platform swap & risk mitigation
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Danielle Ross <danielle@vanta.com>, Matt Chen <matt@trustcenter.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance platform evaluation kickoff - proposed swap approach

Team —

Heads-up: Vanta renewal arrives in 45 days. Renewal comes with a 12-month term and a price bump that Procurement flagged last week. Trust Center reached out with a targeted migration offer and a 6-week onboarding pilot.

I propose we run a short, risk-controlled evaluation to see whether switching vendors gives us:
- ~20–30% unit cost reduction (estimates from their commercial)
- equivalent SOC 2 coverage and evidence automation scope
- predictable handover for customer-facing audits

Attachments: vendor_comparison_20270316.xlsx (spreadsheet with first-pass pricing + feature matrix), renewal_invoice_vanta.pdf

Asks:
- Neha: lead technical evidence mapping + confirm any control gaps if we swap providers.
- Laura: lead commercial negotiations and set renewal hold strategy with finance.
- Karthik: own SOW and legal handoff; will need a bullet list of contract changes we should insist on (data retention, SLAs, exit assistance).

I'll set up a one-hour sync with Trust Center and Vanta to run through controls mapping — suggested slot Fri 3/19 10am PT. Danielle/Matt, please confirm availability.

Thanks,
Connor
Connor O'Brien
Manager, Procurement & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance platform evaluation kickoff - proposed swap approach

Connor — thanks for running point on this. Quick reactions:

1) Calendar: FR 3/19 10am PT works for me.
2) Procurement asks: please confirm current committed spend and any auto-renewal clauses in that Vanta invoice attached. If there's a termination notice window we need to respect, we should note it in the MAP.
3) Finance/credits: if we can extract a pro-rated credit or an early-termination concession, that's a high leverage ask — I'll scope the targets.

Action: Connor, can you paste the exact renewal date and the invoice # from Vanta? Neha — can you flag any compliance blockers by EOD Friday after the sync? Karthik — loop in Legal (I can make intros) once you have SOW bullets.

Laura Bennett
Head of Procurement

From: Matt Chen <matt@trustcenter.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Alec Burns <alec@gke-consulting.io>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Compliance platform evaluation kickoff - proposed swap approach

Hey Connor / team —

Thanks for reaching out. We (Trust Center) can run the 6-week pilot; happy to walk through control mappings on today’s call. A few things up front so the call is actionable:

- Pilot scope: SOC 2 readiness automation for prod and staging; continuous evidence collection for infra + app controls; one live audit checklist simulated with your sample evidence.
- Required access: read-only AWS CloudTrail and IAM reports, access to service accounts for CI/CD artifact capture, SAML metadata for SSO verification.
- Standard pilot T&Cs: 30-day pilot agreement, no charge for initial evidence ingestion, reduced pilot fee if we integrate within 2 weeks.

Product brief: https://trustcenter.com/docs/redwood-brief (internal preview link)

I’ll join the call from SF office — Alec (cc’d) is our integration lead and can answer technical questions.

—Matt
Matt Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer, Trust Center
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Mar 2027 11:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance platform evaluation kickoff - proposed swap approach

Looping in my preliminary evidence matrix (attached: evidence_matrix_neha.xlsx). High-level notes:

- Coverage: Trust Center maps to ~92% of our automated evidence surface out of the box. Missing pieces are two custom app controls (user provisioning events) and our archived log retention artifacts.
- Workarounds: we can backfill provisioning events via a daily lambda that pushes a signed CSV to the evidence bucket (engineering ~2 days effort). For archives, Trust Center recommends a short-term export and link approach for first audit window.
- Risk: If we cutover inside a live audit window there is moderate risk of requiring manual evidence pulls for the first 30 days. Recommend a staged cutover post-audit or keep Vanta as fallback for 60 days.

I recommend the MAP include:
- staged cutover timeline (pilot -> pilot+production -> fallback hold)
- rollback playbook (who does what if evidence fails)
- SLA acceptance criteria for Trust Center (ingestion latency <5m, evidence completeness >98%)

Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Matt Chen <matt@trustcenter.com>, Danielle Ross <danielle@vanta.com>, Alec Burns <alec@gke-consulting.io>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance platform evaluation kickoff - proposed swap approach

Good sync today — notes and next steps below. I attached the first Mutual Action Plan (MAP_v1.docx) for review.

Summary / decisions:
- Pilot approved (6 weeks) with Trust Center; pilot start: 2027-03-29.
- Vanta will remain on a 60-day fallback hold; Laura to negotiate a temporary hold/credit on the renewal by 3/25.
- Neha & Engineering will deliver the evidence backfill lambda by 4/05; Karthik to draft a 60-day exit assistance clause for SOW.

Owners & deadlines:
- Laura: procurement negotiation + finance hold (due 2027-03-25).
- Neha: final evidence matrix update (due 2027-03-26) + pilot acceptance criteria test plan (due 2027-04-08).
- Karthik: SOW draft with exit assistance (due 2027-03-31).
- Alec / Trust Center: pilot onboarding checklist + staging playbook (kickoff 2027-03-29).

Related items: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/8123456 (PROC-2027-0489)
Attachments: MAP_v1.docx (mutual action plan v1)

If nobody objects by EOD tomorrow I’ll mark the deal as pilot-approved in HubSpot and loop Legal for the SOW template. Danielle — appreciate confirmation on Vanta’s acceptance of a 60-day fallback (even as an informal hold) so Laura has leverage in commercial.

Thanks,
Connor
Connor O'Brien
Manager, Procurement & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
